goal: Heartbeat-during-spawn fix + Discord-launcher plugin-wiring audit: bin/codex-spawn.sh refreshes .claude/goal-state/last-beat throughout a Codex generation, exposes the activity via spawn-active.json, the dashboard surfaces source='spawn-active', the supervisor does not false-stall a healthy session, AND every Discord launcher under ~/.claude/channels/discord/start-*.sh is verified to load the long-running-harness plugin.
schema_note: Every item must have passes=false until a fresh evidence file has been Read this session AND the verdict has been reviewed by the evaluator agent. Initial seed and contract amendments are bash-written intentionally; no flips happen at seed time.

items.description: Invoking bin/codex-spawn.sh while it runs causes $WORKDIR/.claude/goal-state/last-beat to be touched (mtime updated) at least 2 times during a synthetic ~75s spawn. Test under tests/heartbeat/spawn-refresh.sh uses a mocked codex binary that sleeps, runs codex-spawn.sh in a tempdir workspace, asserts (a) initial last-beat written within 2s of spawn start, (b) last-beat mtime advances at least 2 additional times during the spawn window, (c) codex-spawn.sh exits with the mock's exit code unchanged (verified for codes 0 and a non-zero like 7).

While a spawn is running, $WORKDIR/.claude/goal-state/spawn-active.json exists and is a JSON object containing at minimum {pid: <int>, started_at: <iso8601>, last_refreshed: <iso8601>, command: 'codex'}. last_refreshed advances on each refresh interval. On clean spawn exit (any exit code) the file is removed within 5s. Test under tests/heartbeat/spawn-refresh.sh asserts all of these in the same tempdir workspace as H1.

scripts/supervisor-runner.sh does NOT emit a stall alert when the active session's workspace has a fresh last-beat regardless of how long the orchestrator turn has been open. New test under tests/heartbeat/supervisor-no-false-stall.sh creates a tempdir workspace, registers it in a tempdir active-ledger, writes last-beat=now-100 and a fresh spawn-active.json, runs supervisor with SUPERVISOR_STALL_THRESHOLD=1200 and SUPERVISOR_RECOVERY_LOG / SUPERVISOR_COMPLETION_LOG pointed at tempdir paths, asserts (a) recovery log does not exist or is empty, (b) the post-queue does not contain a webhook curl entry.

dashboard/lib/collect-state.mjs surfaces heartbeat.source ('stop-hook' | 'spawn-active' | null) and treats a fresh spawn-active.json (last_refreshed within 300s) as a valid heartbeat even when last-beat is missing. New script dashboard/tests/collect-state-spawn-active.mjs seeds a tempdir workspace with a synthetic active.jsonl pointing at it + spawn-active.json + no last-beat-state.json, invokes collectHarnessBundle, asserts (a) heartbeat.source === 'spawn-active', (b) heartbeat.lastBeatAt equals the spawn-active.json last_refreshed, (c) the existing stop-hook path is unaffected — a parallel sub-assertion seeds last-beat / last-beat-state.json without spawn-active.json and asserts source === 'stop-hook'.

All pre-existing tests under tests/ continue to pass after the change. Evidence: evidence/sprint-heartbeat/regression.txt lists every executable test file under tests/ along with its exit code, and every line reads 'PASS rc=0'. Tests run via bash directly (no test framework dependency). The dashboard 'npm run check' (lib/collect-state.mjs + scripts + api) must also pass and be recorded.

README.md gains a paragraph (3-5 lines) under an existing heartbeat-related section that names the two heartbeat sources (stop-hook, spawn-active) and what each one means. docs/observability.md gains a sentence-or-paragraph block describing spawn-active.json schema and what to look for in the tmux layout. CHANGELOG.md gains a single-line entry under a 'Heartbeat-during-spawn' section. Evidence: evidence/sprint-heartbeat/H6-doc-diff.txt with the relevant git diff hunks.

Every executable Discord launcher under ~/.claude/channels/discord/start-*.sh that invokes Claude must pass the harness plugin to it (e.g., via --plugin-dir /Users/marco/.claude/plugins/discord-long-running-harness OR a settings.json entry equivalent that loads the plugin at session start). New script scripts/audit-discord-launchers.sh (in this repo, executable, set -euo pipefail, python3-or-jq fallback) enumerates every start-*.sh launcher, statically inspects each for a recognised plugin-loading directive, and prints one line per launcher in the form 'PASS <slug> <method>' or 'FAIL <slug> <reason>'. Exit code: 0 if every executable launcher passes, non-zero otherwise. Evidence: evidence/sprint-heartbeat/H7-launcher-audit.txt captures the full script output AND a follow-up line stating the exit code. README.md gains a short subsection titled 'Discord launcher audit' describing how and when to run scripts/audit-discord-launchers.sh; CHANGELOG.md mentions the audit script in the same Heartbeat-during-spawn entry as H6.
